bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All four authored OUSG routes are issuer-native canonical deployments. Bridge Risk contains no OUSG representation, bridge adapter, escrow, peer, validator, or bridge-rate-limit control; Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and XRPL issuance authorities remain exclusively in Mint Authority, while Solana freeze and XRPL issuer flags stay in their owning modules. Ondo's documented token bridge covers USDY/GM, not OUSG.
